lines.text:
Why do you keep sneaking glances at me?
Is there... something wrong with my face?

My previous body was aging and needed to be fixed. 
This one should be able to function more efficiently.
Now, I'm ready to rewrite our story.

It's a bit odd only wearing half a mask, but I like it.
It's refreshing.

I am grateful for you.
I'll be able to repay you someday, I promise.

I've used every skill I can recall to repair my body.
It's far from perfect, but we can at least fight together now.
I'm busy. There's much to be done, and time's slipping away.

Whenever I look at you, you always seem so busy.
Do what you need to do. I can wait.

This place is so stable, so peaceful.
It feels... oddly fascinating.
I want to be here... with them.
Someday, I hope our story can continue here as well.

Long-running stories should have happy endings,
and the same goes for your story.
I didn't realize such a thing was possible. Amazing.
You gathered some materials for my enhancement? Thank you.
My equipment has become stronger than before, thanks to you.
Is this... a present? But I didn't prepare anything for you.
This is... exactly what I needed. Thanks.
Superhuman, I'm already so grateful for what you've done. You don't need to keep giving me things.

You trusted me. You helped me.
Now, it's my turn.

It's thanks to you that I was able to rewrite my story.
I will always be thankful.

Stay as you are and never change.
You're not like the other humans, and I like you for that.
If you call, I will come.
I heard.
Moving to the target.
Enemy incoming!
I will eliminate them all.
I will ruin anything that disrupts victory.
I vowed to protect you.
I can go further.
I need time.
Reload.
I can do it.
Let's go full power!
Now. Let's finish this!
Next.
It's over.
Not bad.
Uh.
Ugh...!
Not yet...!
It can't end like this...!
I won't stop until we reach the happy ending.
Do I look like an ordinary person? That would be great if you think so.

These clothes feel awkward.
I don't think I could wear them all the time.
This fabric isn't very form-fitting. It might be uncomfortable to move around in.
Cinderella said I looked beautiful, and that's all that matters.

Regardless of what I wear, my job doesn't change.
I will stand by Cinderella's side and rewrite our story.

Why are you staring? Are you eyeing my clothes?
Cinderella picked them out for me. I can't give them away, not even to you, Superhuman.
What are you doing? If you have nothing to say, I'll go see Cinderella.

I'm not afraid of waiting anymore.
I know there will always be a day when you return.
This is a great place to take a walk with Cinderella.

It's lively here.
But honestly, where we are right now feels just as spirited.

If I get the chance, I'd like to pick out some other outfits here.
... For Cinderella, that is.
Cinderella chose this for me. Does it suit me?
Not yet. I still have to become stronger.
Being strong means being beautiful... Am I beautiful?
I'll protect both you and Cinderella.
This will go well with my outfit. Thanks.
I'll share it with Cinderella.
Someday, I'll make sure to repay you, Superhuman.
Thanks to you, I understand what the meaning of trust is. Thank you.

In the past, I never could have imagined being able to wear ordinary clothes and walk around with Cinderella...
I'm so happy.

Superhuman, I'm curious about your story too.
Will you tell me someday, when the time is right?
I'll go with you.
Did you call me?
Moving out.
Stand back. I'll protect you.
I won't let you get away.
Don't wrinkle my clothes.
We have to fight carefully.
Let's go again.
Is my outfit okay?
I can still fight.
I'm ready.
I'm going all out!
Let's take them down together!
It's taken care of.
That should do it.
Next.
Ugh...!
I can take it...!
Urgh!
The outfit Cinderella picked out... it's ruined...
Let's get back to our daily lives. Cinderella will be waiting for us.
